The trace simulates the archive probes (one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D) after ten externally supplied CC rounds. It changes forgiveness rules, adds last-round defection, adaptive exploitation of unconditional cooperators, and a breakout mechanism after runs of mutual defection.
